wave_status.closed: Closed only in the wave's recorded bounded engineering scope. No later qualification or production authority follows.
wave_status.active: Active only for work selected by the controlling board and ticket. Unselected work and later-wave behavior remain unavailable.
wave_status.planned: Planning and compatibility context only; this wave is not active implementation authority.

ticket_status.done: Done only in the ticket's recorded bounded implementation and test scope; later maturity states remain separately unearned.
ticket_status.in_progress: Selected bounded work is in progress. Completion, qualification, LIVE, production, frontier, and settlement authority are not implied.
ticket_status.todo: Planned on the controlling board; not current implementation permission.
ticket_status.blocked: No affected behavior may advance until the recorded blocker is resolved; unrelated authorized work remains separately governed.

waves.title: Bounded protocol skeleton
waves.authority_ceiling: TESTED only in recorded bounded engineering scope; no scientific, security, network, commercial, or production qualification.
waves.one_line: Prove Carbon's software authority boundaries before real scientific execution.
waves.what: Wave A creates the smallest bounded protocol skeleton that can express a Challenge, a declarative strategy, protected randomness, scoring, submission lifecycle, public-safe disclosure, miner-facing operations, observability, and invariant checks.
waves.why: Carbon cannot trust later scientific or network behavior until the software keeps producers, evaluators, public views, protected data, and economic state in separate authority domains.
waves.success: The A-1 and A0-A12 tickets close in their recorded engineering scopes, the invariant suite passes, and the repository can demonstrate the intended boundaries with fixture-only behavior.
waves.unlocks: Wave B can build science-ready authoring and research contracts on a stable substrate instead of inventing basic lifecycle and authority semantics again.
waves.does_not: Wave A closure does not create scientific, security, network, commercial, production, LIVE, launch, frontier, settlement, weight, or emission authority.

waves.title: Science-ready authoring skeletons
waves.authority_ceiling: Active bounded engineering scope with per-ticket maturity; no wave-level scientific, security, network, commercial, production, or LIVE authority.
waves.one_line: Make one scientific exam authorable and the miner research loop executable with fixtures.
waves.what: Wave B defines the contracts and fixture implementations needed to describe the physical job, generate canonical cases, register truth, define measurements, compile strategies, bound resources, run nominal research and practice, issue receipts, stage priors, and assemble qualification evidence.
waves.why: A real Challenge needs an exact scientific object before Carbon can reconstruct and evaluate a real candidate. Wave B removes ambiguity from the exam and research interfaces while keeping unqualified behavior unavailable.
waves.success: Carbon can demonstrate the board's fixture-only chain from public scientific contracts through a resolved plan, nominal practice and research records, a fixture-official reconstruction path, TEST_ONLY prior handling, and a dossier that still fails closed for LIVE.
waves.unlocks: Wave C can connect one real candidate to one real, qualified single-Challenge execution path.
waves.does_not: Wave B does not include real miner training, production reconstruction, authenticated remote transport, official scientific evidence, LIVE activation, network weights, or learned public priors from official outcomes.

waves.title: Network foundation and real testnet vertical
waves.authority_ceiling: SPECIFIED as post-Wave-B planning context only; no C0/C1/C2 ticket is selected. G3 remains NON_LIVE, NON_SETTLING, NOT_FRONTIER_QUALIFIED, and NOT_MAINNET_ELIGIBLE.
waves.one_line: Establish Bittensor identity and authenticated transport, run one real candidate through the protected exam, and prove temporary direct testnet weights.
waves.what: Wave C is decomposed into C0 network foundation (NET-0 through NET-6), C1 real scientific vertical, and C2 temporary winner-triggered testnet integration (C-W1 through C-W4). Bittensor wraps the Miner MCP; Carbon retains Challenge, evaluation, score, leader, frontier, and settlement authority.
waves.why: Carbon must prove both the chain boundary and one real protected scientific path without letting SDK objects, raw scores, fixtures, stale winners, or incomplete evidence acquire economic authority.
waves.success: G2 proves the localnet adapter, authenticated transport, candidate commitment, structural intent, publication, and readback chain. G3 then proves hotkey-authenticated MCP request through committed candidate, protected exam, signed EvaluationReceipt, TestnetWeightEligibilityEvent, TestnetWinnerWeightIntent, on-chain readback, expiry or supersession, and the explicit no-winner sink.
waves.unlocks: Wave D can qualify the first exact Challenge without mistaking successful testnet publication for scientific qualification.
waves.does_not: Wave C does not authorize LIVE science, Wave-D qualification, FrontierAdvanceEvent creation, treasury settlement, direct-winner mainnet weights, or mainnet activation.

waves.title: Human scientific qualification
waves.authority_ceiling: SPECIFIED as long-horizon planning context only; not implementation permission and not evidence of implementation, testing, or qualification.
waves.one_line: Qualify the first exact Challenge without inferring science from testnet weights.
waves.what: Wave D collects the human-owned scientific decisions that software cannot invent: physical envelope, population adequacy, truth hierarchy, measurement qualification, thresholds, uncertainty policy, disclosure, and exact activation.
waves.why: Passing engineering tests cannot prove that the exam measures the intended physical claim or resolves the decision at the required scientific standard.
waves.success: G4 binds the exact Challenge, population, SamplingPlan, reference and truth assets, measurements, uncertainty, Score Pack, backend profile, security controls, leakage evidence, independent review, and Launch Bar evidence approved by the responsible owners.
waves.unlocks: Wave H becomes the launch-critical successor for frontier promotion and finality; Waves E, F, and G may proceed independently in parallel after D.
waves.does_not: G3 testnet weights do not prove Wave-D success, and one qualified Challenge does not create a FrontierAdvanceEvent, product qualification, commercial repeatability, or settlement correctness.

waves.title: Landscape and evidence memory
waves.authority_ceiling: SPECIFIED as long-horizon planning context only; not implementation permission and not evidence of implementation, testing, or qualification.
waves.one_line: Learn from authoritative experiments without letting learned memory control the judge.
waves.what: Wave E ingests structured ExperimentRecords and models relationships among methods, contexts, and outcomes so Carbon can propose better experiments, priors, scheduling, and Challenge changes.
waves.why: Carbon should compound what it learns across experiments, but learned patterns cannot rewrite a live exam after results become visible.
waves.success: Landscape produces traceable hypotheses and decision support while registered contracts retain scientific authority.
waves.unlocks: Safer search orientation, evidence reuse where rights permit, and later prospective Physics Intelligence tests. This post-D lane does not gate H or I.
waves.does_not: Landscape cannot define truth, alter current Score Packs, reveal protected exam structure, or revise a current frontier result.

waves.title: Product qualification and specialist systems
waves.authority_ceiling: SPECIFIED as long-horizon planning context only; not implementation permission and not evidence of implementation, testing, or qualification.
waves.one_line: Separate search success from deployable product evidence.
waves.what: Wave F qualifies an exact model artifact, runtime, deployment context, limitations, answerability policy, and requalification triggers using a Product Qualification Pack and Product Battery.
waves.why: A candidate can rank well in a Challenge and still lack enough evidence for a customer deployment or a specialist product.
waves.success: Carbon can state what one exact artifact can support, in which context, with which limitations and lifecycle obligations.
waves.unlocks: Qualified model programs, deployment, specialist banks, and recurring requalification work. This post-D lane does not gate H or I.
waves.does_not: Challenge rank does not automatically qualify a product, and component evidence does not automatically qualify a composed system.

waves.title: Commercial, private, and sponsored engagement plane
waves.authority_ceiling: SPECIFIED as long-horizon planning context only; not implementation permission and not evidence of implementation, testing, or qualification.
waves.one_line: Serve real enterprises without moving business authority into the judge.
waves.what: Wave G connects the business canon to scientific execution through engagement, rights, privacy, reference-access, deliverable, acceptance, and economics records.
waves.why: Customers need private deployment, clear rights, bounded deliverables, and commercial acceptance without gaining the power to change scientific evidence rules.
waves.success: Carbon can structure enterprise work with explicit rights, privacy, truth access, deliverables, payment, and lifecycle controls.
waves.unlocks: Evidence Audits, Sponsored Discovery, qualification, lifecycle, private/VPC delivery, and later enterprise platform workflows. This post-D lane does not gate H or I.
waves.does_not: A designed product is not a live capability. Carbon cannot sell an unqualified privacy mode or let payment alter the scientific ruler.

waves.title: Frontier promotion and finality
waves.authority_ceiling: SPECIFIED as long-horizon planning context only; not implementation permission and not evidence of implementation, testing, or qualification.
waves.one_line: Separate ordinary Challenge ranking from verified frontier advance.
waves.what: Wave H introduces FrontierBaseline, FrontierRecord, LeaderReplacementPolicy, FrontierPromotionExam, FrontierAdvanceEvent, ChallengeSetEpoch, appeal, and finality while preserving explicit SUPERIOR, NOT_SUPERIOR, and INDETERMINATE outcomes.
waves.why: A local ranking or floating-point improvement does not prove that a contender moved the scientific frontier on comparable fresh evidence.
waves.success: Carbon promotes a contender only through the registered fresh promotion policy, records one exact finalizable frontier event when the evidence resolves it, and preserves the registered one-event-per-Challenge-settlement-window direction.
waves.unlocks: Event-bound economic settlement and a governed portfolio of Challenges.
waves.does_not: Incumbency does not earn perpetual rewards, unresolved evidence does not create a winner, and scores remain non-comparable across Challenges by default.

waves.title: Mainnet-critical treasury and network settlement
waves.authority_ceiling: SPECIFIED as long-horizon planning context only; not implementation permission and not evidence of implementation, testing, or qualification.
waves.one_line: Route mainnet network allocation to treasury receivers and settle exact per-Challenge obligations without rewriting scientific merit.
waves.what: Wave I owns I-00 treasury receiver/custody/economic contract, I-01 immutable accrual and scientific-economic ledger plus SettlementObligation, I-02 TreasuryRoutingWeightIntent publication, I-03 exactly-once miner settlement, I-04 validator execution and audit economics, and I-05 direct-testnet-to-treasury migration and settlement soak.
waves.why: Mainnet economic activation requires a treasury receiver path, exact event-bound accounting, non-duplicating retries, and evidence that validators execute or audit assigned scientific work instead of merely copying a treasury vector.
waves.success: G6 demonstrates frontier-to-obligation-to-settlement evidence, validator-service incentives and audit controls, no-overlap migration, non-paying rollback, custody and recovery review, and localnet/testnet settlement soak. G7 then requires separate explicit mainnet activation authority.
waves.unlocks: Treasury-routed mainnet economic activation only after legal, economic, governance, security, operational, and launch approval.
waves.does_not: Treasury or chain failure cannot create, erase, or change scientific merit; mainnet has no automatic fallback to direct-winner weights.

waves.title: Model-family neutrality
waves.authority_ceiling: SPECIFIED as long-horizon planning context only; not implementation permission and not evidence of implementation, testing, or qualification.
waves.one_line: Evaluate the registered physical job across qualified model families.
waves.what: Wave J adds reconstruction adapters for additional qualified families such as neural operators, reduced-order models, and hybrid or symbolic-numeric systems.
waves.why: Carbon should reward evidence on the physical task instead of favoring one architecture label or implementation fashion.
waves.success: Different families enter through registered input, output, reconstruction, and evaluation contracts and face the same applicable scientific requirements.
waves.unlocks: Broader discovery supply and fair comparison across model families.
waves.does_not: No family receives scientific privilege because it is neural, mechanistic, symbolic, hybrid, or popular.

waves.title: Generalized agentic construction discovery
waves.authority_ceiling: SPECIFIED as long-horizon planning context only; not implementation permission and not evidence of implementation, testing, or qualification.
waves.one_line: Widen search from training strategies toward construction methods and programs.
waves.what: Wave K expands the participant search object from bounded TrainingStrategy values toward richer ModelConstructionStrategy objects and later ConstructionPrograms.
waves.why: The strongest construction improvements may involve architecture, composition, objectives, curricula, representations, solver hybrids, or staged procedures rather than parameter tuning alone.
waves.success: Agents can propose broader methods through registered representations while the independent evaluator keeps control of official measurements and grades.
waves.unlocks: A larger discovery space without surrendering evaluator independence.
waves.does_not: Construction programs cannot access official evaluator internals or define the measurements that prove their own success.

waves.title: Generalized ReconstructionProtocol
waves.authority_ceiling: SPECIFIED as long-horizon planning context only; not implementation permission and not evidence of implementation, testing, or qualification.
waves.one_line: Run construction in an isolated producer-independent reconstruction plane.
waves.what: Wave L replaces the P0 assumption that fresh retraining is the only rebuild mechanism with a registered ReconstructionProtocol and isolated construction workers.
waves.why: Richer construction methods require explicit resource, environment, dependency, artifact, failure, reproducibility, and isolation contracts before they can produce candidates for official evaluation.
waves.success: An isolated worker turns a registered construction representation into an artifact and ConstructionReceipt, then hands the result across a hard boundary to the evaluator.
waves.unlocks: Secure support for broader construction programs and model families.
waves.does_not: Arbitrary participant code is not a default capability. Carbon widens execution freedom only after security and scientific qualification.

waves.title: Engineering system and product lifecycle
waves.authority_ceiling: SPECIFIED as long-horizon planning context only; not implementation permission and not evidence of implementation, testing, or qualification.
waves.one_line: Qualify exact deployable systems and preserve evidence through change.
waves.what: Wave M handles deployment adapters, portfolios, routers, fallback and abstention, system composition, drift, requalification, envelope expansion, and customer or auditor evidence views.
waves.why: Real engineering systems change across models, data, solvers, hardware, operating envelopes, and deployment context. Qualification must track the exact system identity and change history.
waves.success: Carbon can preserve bounded evidence across a product lifecycle and trigger requalification when a material change breaks the previous identity or claim.
waves.unlocks: Recurring lifecycle, enterprise portfolio, and system-level qualification services.
waves.does_not: End-to-end success does not automatically validate every internal component or future version.

waves.title: Prospective Physics Intelligence
waves.authority_ceiling: SPECIFIED as long-horizon planning context only; not implementation permission and not evidence of implementation, testing, or qualification.
waves.one_line: Prove that accumulated evidence improves future registered decisions.
waves.what: Wave N tests whether Carbon's evidence can improve method choice, intervention choice, transfer prediction, experiment prioritization, risk detection, or qualification evidence allocation.
waves.why: Historical pattern fit can look impressive without helping the next decision. Carbon must measure prospective lift against a registered baseline.
waves.success: Prospective experiments show that Physics Intelligence improves a specified decision with adequate evidence and known limitations.
waves.unlocks: A stronger scientific and commercial intelligence product when the measured lift survives.
waves.does_not: Retrospective correlations or a compelling dashboard do not establish decision value.

maturity.label: Specified
maturity.meaning: A contract or design says what the object or behavior should mean.
maturity.proof: Owning specification, ticket, or ratified decision.
maturity.not_implied: No implementation, test, qualification, or production claim follows.

maturity.label: Implemented
maturity.meaning: Code or an operational artifact exists in the bounded recorded scope.
maturity.proof: Exact implementation identity and merged change.
maturity.not_implied: Implementation can still be scientifically wrong, insecure, or unqualified.

maturity.label: Tested
maturity.meaning: The recorded tests passed for the exact implementation and environment in scope.
maturity.proof: Test commands, results, review identity, and evidence record.
maturity.not_implied: Tests do not establish scientific adequacy or production readiness.

maturity.label: Scientifically qualified
maturity.meaning: Qualified evidence supports the registered scientific use or claim.
maturity.proof: Human scientific review, qualified exam inputs, evidence, and exact decision record.
maturity.not_implied: Security, network, commercial, or production qualification does not follow.

maturity.label: Security qualified
maturity.meaning: The relevant threat model, isolation, access, leakage, and failure controls have acceptable evidence.
maturity.proof: Security review and qualification evidence for the exact topology.
maturity.not_implied: Security approval cannot make weak science valid.

maturity.label: Network qualified
maturity.meaning: The transport, participant, validator, and network-economic path has passed its registered tests.
maturity.proof: Localnet or testnet evidence and network acceptance.
maturity.not_implied: Network operation cannot create scientific merit.

maturity.label: Commercially validated
maturity.meaning: Customers have supplied real evidence that the product and delivery model solve a valuable problem.
maturity.proof: Customer discovery, paid work, repeat delivery, expansion, or recurring evidence as applicable.
maturity.not_implied: A design-specified SKU or scenario is not traction.

maturity.label: Production qualified
maturity.meaning: The exact end-to-end system, context, controls, and operations have passed the production gate.
maturity.proof: Recorded production qualification and activation authority.
maturity.not_implied: Qualification remains bounded to that exact version, context, and limitations.

glossary.definition: A bounded stage in Carbon's development sequence with a system outcome, authority ceiling, and closeout gate.
The smallest authorized unit of work on an active wave board. It owns scope, dependencies, reviewers, non-goals, and definition of done.
A durable choice with rationale, alternatives, affected interfaces, reversibility, and an exact change or supersession path.
The exact repository change where implementation, review findings, repairs, tests, and merge identity live.
The durable proof for what passed, at which identity, in which scope, and with which maturity ceiling.
A registered physical job and its population, case, truth, measurement, evidence, disclosure, and lifecycle contracts.
An exact activated scientific state. Documentation, fixtures, code, or tests cannot imply LIVE.
Keep an affected capability unavailable or return a typed unresolved or infrastructure outcome when required authority or evidence is missing.
An immutable Challenge-level research-orientation artifact. Wave B keeps learned public publication unavailable and uses TEST_ONLY staging.
A later-wave record that a contender moved the verified scientific frontier under a registered promotion policy. It is not the same as leaderboard rank.
A stable hub location such as WAVE-B/B-03 used to place a decision, bug, risk, or evidence update.
